objective: Add test/page/snapshots.test.ts: a test that renders every committed file in snapshots/ (every snapshots/YYYY-MM-DD.json present at test time) with renderPage and fails if any throws, comes out empty, leaks undefined/null/NaN/[object Object], or does not contain its own date. Closes #8.
contract:
Issue #8 Done when (verbatim):
- A test renders every committed file in `snapshots/` and fails if any of them throws or comes out empty (O-4, P-5)
- The test reads files only from disk, with no network calls (P-6)

Facts measured at base cf20405:
- snapshots/ holds one file today: 2026-11-16.json (schemaVersion 1). The Snapshot Action adds one or two per day, so discover files with readdirSync, never a hard-coded list, and fail (not pass vacuously) if zero snapshot files are found.
- Signature: `export function renderPage(s: Snapshot, history: string[], isLatest: boolean): string` in src/page.ts. Pass history = all discovered dates sorted newest first, isLatest = (date === newest).
- Existing test/page/render.test.ts loads the fixture with `JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL("../fixtures/snapshot.json", import.meta.url), "utf8")) as Snapshot` and asserts `expect(html).not.toMatch(/>\s*(undefined|null|NaN)\s*</)` and `not.toContain("[object Object]")`. Reuse the same assertions; do not edit render.test.ts.
- How the date appears in the rendered page: read src/page.ts for how s.date is printed and assert on that exact form (read the code, do not guess).
- Never edit or create files in snapshots/ (P-5). src/types.ts is inlined below for reference.
- One test per file (it.each or a loop of it), so a failure names the broken day.
Gate at base: 4 files, 35 tests passed.
negative: Do not edit files outside scope: src/types.ts, glossary.json, snapshots/, test/fixtures/, docs, .github, render.yaml, root files and the lockfile belong to the coordinator.
No new dependencies. No live network calls in tests. Never read, print or commit a token or key (P-6).
rubric: Prove the test can fail: temporarily break something locally (e.g. render a deliberately damaged in-memory copy, or point discovery at an empty list) and confirm red, then revert; describe what you did in the return. The committed test modifies no file on disk.
The test fails if zero snapshot files are found.
pnpm test and pnpm typecheck clean from the repo root.
files_changed lists every file changed in cf20405..your head. Commit message references O-4, P-5 and #8.
